prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1289; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating to the base of the skull. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, particularly with rotation and extension, along with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild guarding. Neurological screening showed intact strength, sensation, and reflexes in both upper extremities, and there were no signs of radiculopathy or red-flag findings. The working diagnosis was cervical strain with associated muscle spasm.

Over six visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, guided therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and home exercise instruction with postural education. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily across the course of care. By the final visit, the patient reported substantial reduction in neck pain and headache frequency, with near-full cervical range of motion and only occasional stiffness after prolonged positioning. The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program, with instructions to return if symptoms worsened or new neurological symptoms developed.
